fusions.name: Flower to Flower
fusions.desc: Sends a forager at the first enemy it meets, which deals 4 damage, then goes on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that. Each sting has a 30% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Extractor Spin
fusions.desc: Spins you in a full circle that deals 26 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves each one [Slowed] for 5 seconds. When it hits, every ally deals 20% more damage for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Idle
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it. For 8 seconds a swarm circles you and stings a nearby enemy for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Capped Cells
fusions.desc: Every hit you land fills a stack on you, up to 8. At 8 the stacks all spend at once: you heal for 5% of your maximum health per stack (40% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
